briefdescription.para: Simply computes the gradient of the quadratic cost $ J(x, u) = \sum_{j=1}^{N-1} \ell_j(x^j, u^j) + \ell_N(x^N) $, with $ \ell_j(x, u) = \tfrac12 \left\| \begin{pmatrix} x - x^j_\text{ref} \\ u - u^j_\text{ref} \end{pmatrix} \right\|_{H_j}^2 $, with the Hessian $ H_j = \begin{pmatrix} Q_j & S_j^\top \\ S_j & R_j \end{pmatrix} $.
